critical_code_review_comments: sheet_sync.sync_from_sheet uses $set + $setOnInsert with upsert on (sheet_id, source=sheet) -> idempotent and preserves the booking id/created_at across re-syncs; verified by test_sheet_sync_idempotent.
sheet_sync removes stale sheet bookings via delete_many({source:sheet, sheet_id: {$nin: seen}}) -> edits in the sheet (deletion/rename) will reflect; stock recomputed from fleet each run.
parse_sheet correctly derives size from 'TG S|M|L|XL' and category from EG/GR/EB prefixes; out-of-service / sold units excluded via substring check on status (servizio|venduta).

Backend /bookings sets phone on booking and persists on user only when a non-empty phone is supplied; falls back to user.phone if omitted -> prefill works (/api/auth/me returns phone and checkout.tsx uses it as default state).
Frontend checkout gates confirm button on phoneOk = digits>=6 AND availability>0 -> prevents sending empty phone; nice UX could add inline error, but requirement (disabled until >=6 digits) is met.
